concerns.text: T036 mandates a fallback to `itertools.islice` sampling if streaming fails, explicitly stating 'Do NOT use synthetic data' and 'The script MUST NOT fail loudly'. This silently relaxes FR-001 and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility), which require the system to ingest the *full* ARC-Bench subset or fail if the data cannot be accessed. Sampling introduces non-deterministic data loss that invalidates the statistical power of the study and violates the 'Verified Accuracy' gate by potentially excluding required failure modes.

T013 defines a fallback sequence to 'regex-based heuristic distillation' if LLMs fail RAM checks or coverage is <90%. While the spec allows model fallback, replacing the core 'CPU-tractable small language model' requirement (FR-002) with a regex heuristic fundamentally changes the research artifact from 'distilled rules via LLM' to 'hand-crafted regex'. This violates the core hypothesis (US-1) that specific failure structures can be *distilled* by an LLM, effectively weakening the requirement to a simpler, non-LLM solution without explicit spec authorization.

T021c restricts baseline instrumentation to 'Local Mode Only' and raises an error if `--external` is passed. However, FR-004 and the Plan explicitly require comparing the rule engine against the 'full AutoResearchClaw baseline agent' executed on 'standard resources' (external/larger runner). By blocking instrumentation for the external baseline, T021c prevents the collection of the 'Time-to-Pivot' and resource metrics required by FR-004 and SC-005 for the baseline, rendering the comparative study impossible as defined in the spec.

T030b explicitly EXCLUDES external baseline metrics from the `resource_summary.json`, stating it reflects 'CI-constrained tasks only'. This violates SC-005, which requires measuring the 'total compute time and peak memory usage of the *entire experiment* (data processing, distillation, execution, analysis)' against GitHub Actions limits. By omitting the baseline execution costs (which are part of the experiment), the task delivers a partial metric that fails the acceptance criterion for the full resource audit.
